title: The Launch Decision
subtitle: Controlled User Group Rollout · Production Readiness & Pilot Assessment
description: The Phase 1 build is deployed to staging and has passed initial functional tests. Evaluate production readiness evidence across 80,000 bank employees, isolate critical launch blockers, configure a 500-user 48-hour pilot, and establish evidence-based expansion gates.

stakeholders.name: Daniel Kapoor
stakeholders.agenda: Confirming core functional tests, API gateway connectivity, and technical checklist.

stakeholders.name: Aarav Kapoor
stakeholders.agenda: Protecting delivery baseline, separating prerequisites from pilot tasks, and ensuring user safety.

stakeholders.name: Marcus Reed
stakeholders.agenda: Enforcing 80,000-employee scale validation, strict InfoSec approvals, and zero unverified rollouts.

objectives.label: Review Phase 1 readiness evidence across functional, security, and load domains
Identify non-negotiable launch blockers and establish recovery acceptance criteria
Build a controlled 500-user pilot rollout plan with monitoring and rollback gates
